newsitem.title: USA: Clinton again calls for fast-track trade authority.
newsitem.headline: Clinton again calls for fast-track trade authority.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Thursday called for Congress to give him "fast track" trade negotiating authority and said that the Latin American states are the United States' greatest area of economic opportunity.

"We really need to pass the fast track authority, we need to do it this year, and we need to do it as soon as possible," Clinton told the Business Council industry group in a speech, adding: "Our neighbors to the south of us are still our greatest opportunity for the future."

Clinton met Chilean President Eduardo Frei on Wednesday and assured him he was committed to completing a free trade agreement with Chile, telling Frei that he wanted so-called "fast track" trade negotiation authority from Congress.
That authority would allow U.S. trade officials to negotiate an agreement with Chile without fear it would later be changed by Congress.
